segments.name: Retail real estate
segments.description: Owns and operates retail properties anchored by credit-worthy tenants, including grocery stores and big-box retailers.
segments.evidence: The Company's retail portfolio is concentrated in high-barrier-to-entry markets and is anchored by credit-worthy tenants, including grocery stores and big-box retailers.

segments.name: Office real estate
segments.description: Owns Class A office space in mixed-use town centers, such as the Town Center of Virginia Beach and Harbor Point in Baltimore.
segments.evidence: The office portfolio consists primarily of Class A office space located in mixed-use town centers, such as the Town Center of Virginia Beach and Harbor Point in Baltimore.

segments.name: Multifamily real estate
segments.description: Owns and operates luxury apartment communities, primarily within its mixed-use developments, providing stable cash flows.
segments.evidence: The Company owns and operates luxury apartment communities, primarily within its mixed-use developments.

segments.name: Real estate financing
segments.description: Provides preferred equity financing for development projects that serve as a pipeline for future acquisition of stabilized assets.
segments.evidence: This segment encompasses the Company's preferred equity investments.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent to the property segments, and borrowers pay interest on the real estate financing segment's investments.
revenueModel.evidence: Segment revenues include rental revenues for our property segments and interest income for our real estate financing segment.

changes.text: In 2025 the company committed to sell its general contracting and real estate services segment, which is now presented as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: During the fourth quarter of December 31, 2025, the Company completed a strategic review of its operations and committed to a plan to sell its general contracting and real estate services segment.

changes.text: In 2026 the company announced it would exit the multifamily property sector and divest its construction and real estate financing businesses.
changes.evidence: On February 16, 2026, we announced a fundamental business restructuring to eliminate complexity, strengthen the balance sheet, and relentlessly focus on operating a streamlined real estate platform.
